title: Holiday Board Giveaway Recap
body:
This past December, ODA partnered with four local businesses and two corporate sponsors to run our biggest board giveaway yet. Over two days at Collins Park Recreation Center, we distributed 48 complete skateboard setups to Toledo youth who couldn't otherwise afford gear.

Each setup included a full-size deck, trucks, wheels, bearings, and hardware — everything a kid needs to start skating today. Age-appropriate sizing was matched to each recipient, and our volunteers were on hand to answer questions from parents.

The response from families was overwhelming. We had kids show up who had never touched a skateboard before and left with the tools to start something new. That's what ODA is here for.

"My son won't put it down. He's been in the driveway every day since." — Toledo parent
